criteria.description: Leads with Not ready, prioritising the observed cross-workspace data exposure and also noting the failed state-preservation requirement.
Covers search scope, tenant isolation and preservation of query and filters on return.
Treats the preview failures as stronger evidence than green CI and happy-path tests.
Connects the workspace-agnostic cache key to the tenant-boundary risk without claiming more than the evidence supports.
Requires tenant-safe cache scoping and tests, plus query/filter restoration and a focused regression test before shipping.
Explains the customer and data consequence clearly.
